description: Petroleum Title Polygons is a dataset listed in British Columbia data catalogue (BC Data Catalogue), an open data portal, published or maintained by Tenure and Resource Stewardship. All tenures recorded in the Integrated Petroleum Tenure System. Status Types: A- active, C- cancelled, N-not issued, P- pending sale, R- unaccepted bid, U- no bid, W- withdrawn. Coverage: British Columbia. The portal files it under the publisher Tenure and Resource Stewardship. Its tags are Oil Gas Tenure, PNG Tenure, geothermal tenure, petroleum tenure. It offers 3 resource(s) in KML, WMS, ZIP. The portal shows 2026-09-29 as the last update. It is reached through the links recorded on this page, with the catalogue entry as the discovery route. Access is free of charge and open. The licence is Access Only. Caveats: this record was written from the catalogue listing only, so the linked page was not opened, its contents and current availability were not checked, and the description may lag the source. It can support fuel supply studies. Related record: the catalogue-level record data-am-bc-portal.
